mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month predicts positive 20-day S&P 500 returns as it signals accommodative monetary policy, lowering discount rates on equity cash flows.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS declines but 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) or the decline is not sustained over the month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate above 5% indicates weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 returns as investors anticipate reduced corporate profits and economic slowdown.
failure_condition: If UNRATE remains above 5% but 20-day returns are positive or not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in GDPC1 (total personal consumption expenditures) and HOUST (industrial production) signal robust demand growth, driving positive 5-day S&P 500 returns through increased corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: If both GDPC1 and HOUST rise but 5-day returns are negative or the correlation between them is weak (R² < 0.3).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the CPIAUCSL index above 5% signals inflationary pressures, prompting market concerns and negative 60-day S&P 500 returns as investors anticipate higher interest rates.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL remains above 5% but 60-day returns are positive or not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Convergence of PAYEMS (employment) and UNRATE (unemployment) towards positive trends reflects a strengthening labor market, leading to positive 20-day S&P 500 returns as corporate profits and consumer spending are expected to rise.
failure_condition: If both PAYEMS and UNRATE show positive trends but 20-day returns are negative or the correlation between them is weak (R² < 0.3).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO (supply index) above 115 indicates robust manufacturing and production activity, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If INDPRO remains above 115 but 5-day returns are negative or not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a sustained decline in FEDFUNDS predicts positive 20-day S&P 500 returns as investors anticipate further easing and lower discount rates on equity valuations.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decline occurs in a late-cycle but 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) or the decline is not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL indices signal deflationary monetary policy, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL decline but 60-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) or their correlation is weak (R² < 0.3).
